login.title: Sign in to rooster
login.subtitle: Use the account your organisation gave you.
login.inviteOnly: rooster is invite-only. New here? Ask for an invite link.

noProviders.title: No sign-in options yet
noProviders.body: No sign-in provider is configured. Ask the person who runs this rooster to set one up.

not_invited.title: You’re not on the list yet
not_invited.body: That account isn’t invited. Ask someone in your organisation for an invite link.

disabled.title: Your account is disabled
disabled.body: An administrator has turned off this account. Contact them to get access again.

invite_invalid.title: That invite no longer works
invite_invalid.body: It has expired, been revoked or already been used. Ask for a new link.

failed.title: Sign-in didn’t work
failed.body: Something went wrong with the provider. Try again in a moment.

notInvited.title: You’re not on the list yet
notInvited.body: rooster is invite-only, and this account isn’t invited.
notInvited.bodyWithEmail: rooster is invite-only, and {email} isn’t invited.
notInvited.askLink: Ask someone in your organisation to send you an invite link.
notInvited.askAdmin: Or ask the administrator to add your email address or domain.

disabled.title: Your account is disabled
disabled.body: An administrator has turned off this account. Contact them to get access again.

unverified.title: Verify your email first
unverified.body: Your sign-in provider hasn’t confirmed this email address. Verify it there, then try again.

linkBlocked.title: Sign in the way you did before
linkBlocked.body: This sign-in method can’t be used for an existing account. Sign in the way you did before.

invite.title: Join {org}
invite.failed: Couldn’t accept the invite. Try again.

expired.title: This invite has expired
expired.body: Invites to {org} last a limited time. Ask for a new link.

revoked.title: This invite was revoked
revoked.body: An owner of {org} withdrew it. Ask them for a new link.

used.title: This invite has been used
used.body: It was a single-use link. Ask an owner of {org} for a new one.

notFound.title: Invite not found
notFound.body: Check that you copied the whole link.

invite.emailMismatch: This invite is for a different email address.

enter.title: Connect a device
enter.body: Enter the code shown in your terminal.
enter.label: Code

request.title: Connect {client}?
request.body: {client} is asking for access to your rooster account ({account}). Choose what it may do and where.
request.checkCode: Check that your terminal shows this code

done.approvedBody: You can go back to your terminal.
done.deniedBody: Nothing was connected. Your terminal shows that access was denied.

notFound.title: That code doesn’t match a waiting request
notFound.body: It may be mistyped, expired or already used. Check the code in your terminal, or run rooster login again for a new one.

expired.title: This code has expired
expired.body: Run rooster login again to get a new code.

used.title: This code has already been used
used.body: Run rooster login again to connect another device.

device.approveFailed: Couldn’t approve the device. Try again.
device.denyFailed: Couldn’t deny the request. Try again.

consent.title: Allow {client} to use your rooster account?
consent.body: {client} is asking for access to your rooster account ({account}). Choose what it may do and where. Only allow apps you trust.
consent.verifiedHint: rooster checked that this domain publishes the app.
consent.unverifiedHint: rooster couldn’t check who publishes this app.
consent.unverifiedBody: The app’s details don’t match where it sends you back to. Allow it only if you just connected it yourself.
consent.dynamicBody: This app registered itself, so its name and logo may not be what they seem. Allow it only if you just connected it yourself.
consent.stepUp: {client} already has access and is asking for more. New capabilities are marked.
consent.denyFailed: Couldn’t deny the request. Try again.

invalid.title: This request can’t be used
invalid.body: It may have expired or already been answered. Go back to the app and connect again.

failed.title: Couldn’t load the request
failed.body: Check your connection and try again.
